text.p: The following is a tentative calendar for the drawing up and presentation of Spain's 1997 budget.
- (Before Oct 1) The Popular Party government presents its draft budget bill, expected to be approved by the cabinet on September 27, to the lower house of parliament
- (In the following 15 to 20 days) Parliamentary committee meets to introduce budget bill into parliament. During this period, opposition political parties may introduce rival draft budgets.
- Parliamentary debate on the government's budget draft and competing drafts.

If the legislature does not reject the opposition initiatives, the government has failed to obtain the votes needed to push the budget through and the prior year's budget will eventually be renewed, as occurred with the 1996 budget.

But this is highly unlikely since the government holds the absolute majority of 176 seats. The Popular Party holds 156 while its allies the Catalonian Convergencia y Union and the Canary Coalition, hold 16 and four, respectively.

- (In the following one to two weeks). If the plenary rejects the opposition budget drafts, a coalition committee representing all parties will meet behind closed doors to hammer out agreement on individual amendments to the draft. This report is returned to the Congressional Budget Committee which in public prepares a working document.
- The Congressional Budget Committee working document is submitted to the lower house plenary and to the Senate for final debate.
- (End of December) Final date for approval of the budget.
